tagline: Your books. Your space. Your reading experience.
reviewNote: Reviewed for our current launch plans and longer-term product direction.

publication.notice: We are preparing Aflow Read’s first public App Store release. Explore the intended launch foundation below while final release checks are completed.

expectations: This roadmap shares our direction, not guaranteed release commitments. Priorities, scope and order may change as we learn from readers and testing. No release dates or future prices are promised.
philosophy: A native reading experience for iPhone and iPad, built around the books you own. Basic reading and library management should not depend on a subscription, a cloud service or an external library-management tool.

performance.title: A growing library should still feel like yours.
performance.description: Responsiveness is a continuing priority across every phase: fast browsing, efficient cover loading and updates that focus on changed books. We are building for larger personal collections without promising a fixed book-count or device-performance guarantee.

sections.title: Available Now
sections.description: The first public App Store release is still being prepared. Here is a preview of its intended foundation. Released features will appear here once they are publicly available.
sections.emptyMessage: Public availability will be confirmed here when the first release is ready.

sections.title: Up Next
sections.description: Broader reading formats, building on the current EPUB focus. Each format will be tested and refined before its support is confirmed.

sections.title: Planned
sections.description: After the expanded format foundation: Smart Library and organization first, followed by Calibre integration.

sections.title: Exploring
sections.description: Directions we want to investigate. Inclusion here is not a promise that every capability will ship.

launchFoundation.title: A comfortable EPUB reader
launchFoundation.description: Portrait and landscape reading with Automatic, Single Page and Facing Pages. Columns adapt to usable reading width.
details: Reading appearance customization, progress and saved position.
Contents, supported text search, bookmarks and Go Back.
Supported illustrations and image navigation; availability depends on the EPUB.

launchFoundation.title: Your library, under your control
launchFoundation.description: Import supported EPUB files or nested folders, browse and search your Bookshelf, and organize books into collections.
details: Multiple sources, source inspection and refresh.
Bring child-folder sources together under a parent while preserving existing book identity and reading state.
Metadata and cover overrides, removed-book recovery and local reading state.

launchFoundation.title: Native, adaptable layouts
launchFoundation.description: Native iPhone and iPad interfaces that respond to the space available.
details: Layouts adapt to available reading space in portrait and landscape.
Device compatibility details will be confirmed alongside the public release.

launchFoundation.title: Free reading. Optional support.
launchFoundation.description: The initial release is planned to be Free, with no subscription required.
details: Optional Buy Us a Coffee consumable support purchases are subject to final App Store qualification and unlock no additional reading features.
Lifetime Pro is not offered at the initial launch.

features.title: PDF: build on existing support
features.description: Build on existing PDF import and reading support, with further work to complete and qualify the experience across a wider range of documents.
details: Reliable opening, rendering, fit/zoom and navigation.
Page-position persistence, supported bookmarks and library integration.
Test larger documents while keeping memory use predictable.

features.title: Plain text, thoughtfully presented
features.description: Explore TXT import and reading with dependable text handling and a place in your personal library.
details: Unicode and character-encoding handling.
Readable typography, navigation and saved progress.
Metadata integration and appropriate large-file behaviour.

features.title: Comics and image-based reading
features.description: Expand toward CBZ and suitable image collections. CBR support depends on compatibility and licensing evaluation.
details: Full-page presentation, fit/zoom and appropriate reading direction.
Efficient image loading, saved progress and supported bookmarks.
Supported archive and compression variations will be confirmed after testing.

features.title: Tags and Smart Library
features.description: Add user-defined tags and collections that fill themselves using rules, built around one logical library.
details: Tag editing, filtering and search.
Potential rules for author, title, tags, format, reading status and available metadata.
Organization should preserve book identity and reading data.

features.title: More ways to find and organize books
features.description: Develop combined filters, better sorting and useful saved views for larger collections.
details: Explore bulk metadata editing and better metadata inspection.
Make relationships between multiple linked files easier to understand. Multiple files linked to one book do not necessarily have identical contents.
Keep organization efficient as the library grows, without repeated full scans.

features.title: Calibre, after the library foundation
features.description: Bring useful Calibre-managed books and metadata into Aflow Read after tags and organization are established.
details: Explore practical import or transfer workflows, metadata, tags, authors and series.
The mechanism is undecided: file/export workflows or compatible server access may be considered.
No promise of wireless bidirectional sync, metadata editing or full Calibre library control. Calibre will not be required for basic use.

features.title: Optional Apple-device synchronization
features.description: Explore progress, bookmarks, collections, preferences and library restoration across supported Apple devices. Cross-device library and reading-state sync is not part of the initial release.
details: Keep synchronization optional and basic local reading independent.
Preserve meaningful local reading state when sessions diverge; let the reader choose an opening position without silently destroying the alternative.
Automatic synchronization of every file or setting is not promised. Accessing files in iCloud Drive is different from syncing your library and reading state.

features.title: More ways to make reading yours
features.description: Explore richer themes, presets, typography choices, layout controls and accessibility options.
details: Build on the existing appearance tools.
Future scope and availability will be decided after design and qualification.

features.title: Reading insights that respect privacy
features.description: Explore helpful reading history, time, habits and progress summaries without invasive tracking or required external analytics.
details: Useful personal information rather than a requirement to share reading activity.
Specific metrics and data handling are not yet announced.

features.title: Keep improving everyday reading
features.description: Continue work on navigation, chapter transitions, complex EPUBs, image-heavy books, accessibility and supported language or reading-direction scenarios.
details: Prioritize demonstrated reader needs and verified improvements.
Preserve reading positions and library integrity as the experience evolves.
